# Artsdata / Nebula

> Artsdata is Canada's arts and culture knowledge graph. Nebula is the
> low-code RDF viewer and admin front-end for Artsdata: it lets people
> browse, search, reconcile, and mint Artsdata identifiers for entities
> (organizations, people, places, events) described as Linked Open Data
> (RDF/JSON-LD/schema.org), and it publishes bulk RDF data dumps and a
> public SPARQL endpoint for programmatic and AI-agent access.

## Data dumps

- [Artsdata Core data dumps](https://kg.artsdata.ca/data-dumps): human-readable
  list of downloadable RDF dumps (e.g. the monthly Artsdata Core dump with
  provenance/RDF-star annotations removed), each also described as a
  dcat:Distribution in embedded JSON-LD on that page for machine discovery
  of the downloadURL, mediaType and byteSize.

## Programmatic / agent access

- MCP server: https://mcp.artsdata.ca/mcp (Model Context Protocol,
  JSON-RPC over HTTP). Exposes:
  - Tools: search_entities, get_entity, search_events, get_schema, sparql_query
  - Resources: the Artsdata Core (minus provenance) RDF dump manifest,
    readable via resources/list and resources/read
- SPARQL endpoint: https://query.artsdata.ca/query — public read-only
  SPARQL 1.1 endpoint over the full Artsdata knowledge graph. Use get_schema
  (via the MCP server) to learn the data model before writing queries.

## Notes for agents

- Prefer the MCP server's get_schema + sparql_query tools, or the SPARQL
  endpoint directly, over scraping Nebula's HTML pages.
- The data-dumps page's JSON-LD (`<script type="application/ld+json">`,
  `@graph` of `dcat:Distribution` nodes) is the authoritative place to find
  current downloadURLs for bulk RDF dumps without parsing HTML.
